observation:
TITLE: Tromeo and Juliet
URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tromeo_and_Juliet
EXCERPT: Tromeo and Juliet is a 1996 American independent transgressive romantic black comedy film and a loose adaptation of the play Romeo and Juliet by William Shakespeare from Troma Entertainment. The film was directed by Lloyd Kaufman from a screenplay he co-wrote with James Gunn, who also served as associate director.
The film is a loose adaptation of the play, as it includes the extreme amounts of sexuality and violence characteristic of Troma, as well as a revised ending. The film's title is a blend of "Troma" and "Romeo and Juliet".

TITLE: List of William Shakespeare screen adaptations
URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_William_Shakespeare_screen_adaptations
EXCERPT: The Guinness Book of Records lists 410 feature-length film and TV versions of Shakespeare's plays, making Shakespeare the most filmed author ever in any language.
As of October 2026, the Internet Movie Database lists Shakespeare as having writing credit on 1,900 films, including those under production but not yet released. The earliest known production is King John from 1899.
